explication: NGINX Ingress Controller watches Kubernetes routing resources, validates and translates them into NGINX configuration, then applies that configuration to the NGINX data plane. The README documents standard Ingress, VirtualServer/VirtualServerRoute, and TransportServer workflows, including HTTP/TLS routing and TCP/UDP/TLS passthrough. Separate controllers support certificate-manager and ExternalDNS integrations; WAF/DoS and telemetry are additional capabilities. The graph reflects the documented product scope and sampled controller/manager behavior; unsampled subsystem wiring is not assumed.
